name: Session Capture Hook
description: A session hook for Claude Code and Codex that captures one summary thought per episode of a session into Open Brain — a piece of work, cut at compactions, moves to another branch or checkout, and new tickets — at each compaction and at session end: what was asked, what came out, what changed, with the thoughts that piece retrieved as its provenance, through a capture-only key, after a secret scan that blanks what it finds. Off until you paste the hooks it prints.
